tool_args.rationale: The pilot responses depend on both input and gradient, but the sparse, confounded observations leave the governing branch ambiguous. The open-branch probe is the lowest-cost available discriminating measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the recalled avalanche-siphon, Haldane, or Cobb–Douglas model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations with coupled changes in u_now and s_grad do not reliably distinguish these mechanisms or identify a more complex alternative.
The immediate ambiguity is the response branch, not time resolution; the discriminating probe costs less.
It is not relevant to identifying the target law.
